- ep_7f2f41: lme_a is planning a July or August trip to the Eastern Sierra and asked for camping spots and hiking trails. lme_a had just returned from a solo camping trip to Yosemite National Park on 2023-05-17 and wanted to get back into the mountains. The assistant also referred to a recent Vernal Falls hike that lme_a had not mentioned in this window, so that detail is unverified. lme_a asked about gear from Mammoth Lakes outfitters; the assistant listed essentials and named Mammoth Mountain Gear, The Trailhead and REI Mammoth Lakes.
